synopsis: ISO 15998 was the former functional-safety standard for electronic machine-control systems on earth-moving machinery [f15250, f2705]. ISO 15998:2008 and its companion ISO/TS 15998-2:2012 were withdrawn on 14 June 2022 and replaced by the ISO 19014 series [f2344, f15251]. A legacy-reference tension remains: ISO 16001:2017 still cites ISO 15998 for environmental conditions, but explicitly permits ISO 19014-3 as an alternative [f2345, f15252]. Old supplier data sheets may continue citing the withdrawn standard, creating a risk in fast-moving projects; readers should treat such references as dated and request the ISO 19014 equivalent [f15257, f15253].
